publications.title: Cluster-Aware Attention-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Pickup and Delivery Problems

detail.en: Manuscript under revision. An arXiv preprint is available separately.

summary.en: A clustering-aware attention model for neural pickup-and-delivery routing, with a multiscale encoder and a hierarchical dual-branch decoder.
summary.zh: 面向取送货路径优化的聚类感知注意力模型，结合多尺度编码器与分层双分支解码器。

publications.title: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
publications.venue: The 33rd International Conference on Neural Information Processing (ICONIP 2026)

summary.en: Observation-aware feature-source tokens, missingness modeling, conditioned Transformer fusion, and recursive refinement for mental-health assessment.
summary.zh: 通过观测感知特征源 token、缺失模式建模、条件化 Transformer 融合和递归细化，开展心理健康评估。

detail.zh: IEEE CPS · 2025 年 8 月 · 第 74–79 页

summary.en: Clustering and LSTM-based counterfactual predictions combined with multi-period difference-in-differences to study cybercrime indicators and policy effects.
summary.zh: 结合聚类、LSTM 反事实预测与多期双重差分，分析网络犯罪指标及政策效果。

title.en: Learning to route, across spatial scales.
title.zh: 从空间聚类到路径决策。

role.en: Co-first author · Advisor: Prof. Guangyu Zou, DUT
role.zh: 共同第一作者 · 导师：大连理工大学 Guangyu Zou 教授

description.en: This project develops CAADRL for pickup-and-delivery problems with pairing and precedence constraints in spatially clustered instances. Global self-attention and intra-cluster attention capture multiscale structure; a hierarchical decoder handles route selection within and between clusters.
description.zh: 本项目面向具有空间聚类结构的取送货问题，在配对与先后顺序约束下构建 CAADRL 模型。通过全局自注意力和簇内注意力提取多尺度空间特征，再以分层解码器处理簇内路径选择与簇间转移。

alt.en: CAADRL architecture from the research manuscript, showing its attention encoder and routing decoder.
alt.zh: 论文中的 CAADRL 模型架构，展示注意力编码器与路径解码器。

contribution.en: I reproduced the NCS baseline, designed and analyzed ablation studies, prepared experimental figures, and contributed to evaluation across problem sizes and data distributions.
contribution.zh: 我负责 NCS 基线复现、消融实验设计与分析及实验图表制作，并参与不同问题规模与数据分布下的评估。

figure_caption.zh: 模型架构 · 论文原图 2

title.zh: 让不完整观测参与有效融合。

label.zh: 多视图学习 · 心理健康

role.en: Co-first author · Advisor: Prof. Guangyu Zou, DUT
role.zh: 共同第一作者 · 导师：大连理工大学 Guangyu Zou 教授

description.en: This project proposes MC-TRCM to fuse heterogeneous mobile and wearable features under substantial missingness. Feature-source tokens and missing-aware gating feed a conditioned Transformer; recursive decoding refines predictions across six regression and classification tasks on DepreST-CAT and PSYCHE-D.
description.zh: 本项目提出 MC-TRCM，在大量缺失观测下融合异构移动设备与可穿戴特征。以特征源 token 和缺失感知门控结合条件化 Transformer，再通过递归解码细化预测；在 DepreST-CAT 与 PSYCHE-D 的六个回归和分类任务上开展评估。

alt.en: MC-TRCM architecture from the research manuscript, showing observation-aware tokens, fusion, and recursive refinement.
alt.zh: 论文中的 MC-TRCM 架构，展示观测感知 token、特征融合与递归细化。

contribution.en: I contributed to multi-source data processing, model design, and experimental validation, including baseline comparisons, ablations, and analysis of missingness modeling and recursive prediction.
contribution.zh: 我参与多源数据处理、模型设计与实验验证，包括基线对比、消融实验，以及缺失模式建模和递归预测机制的分析。

title.en: Multidimensional Metrics Analysis Based on K-Means Clustering and LSTM-Multi-Period DiD
title.zh: 网络犯罪指标与政策效果评估

summary.en: Analyzed crime, reporting, and prosecution indicators from 110 countries. Combined K-means, LSTM counterfactuals, and multi-period difference-in-differences to evaluate policies in China, Germany, and the United States. Published at CIPAE 2025.
summary.zh: 分析 110 个国家的犯罪、报案与起诉指标，结合 K-means、LSTM 反事实预测和多期双重差分，评估中国、德国与美国的政策效果。成果发表于 CIPAE 2025。

contribution.en: I implemented K-means clustering, correlation analysis and visualizations, developed the LSTM–multi-period DiD experimental pipeline, and performed data cleaning and sensitivity analysis.
contribution.zh: 我完成 K-means 聚类、相关分析与可视化，构建 LSTM–多期 DiD 实验流程，并开展数据清洗与敏感性分析。

title.zh: 高分辨率臭氧降尺度预测

role.en: Project leader · Advisor: Prof. Libin Jiao, DUT
role.zh: 项目负责人 · 导师：大连理工大学 Libin Jiao 教授

summary.en: Combined GEOS-Chem, ERA5, and ground observations on a 0.01° × 0.01° grid. Compared tree and neural models with cross-validation, Model Confidence Set testing, and SHAP analysis of atmospheric-chemistry consistency.
summary.zh: 融合 GEOS-Chem、ERA5 与地面监测数据，统一到 0.01° × 0.01° 网格。比较树模型与神经网络，以交叉验证、模型置信集检验与 SHAP 分析评估性能及大气化学一致性。

contribution.en: I implemented data preprocessing and spatial interpolation, trained and tuned the models, evaluated performance, and visualized MCS and SHAP analyses.
contribution.zh: 我负责多源数据预处理与空间插值、模型训练和调参、性能评估，以及 MCS 检验与 SHAP 分析的可视化。

image_caption.en: GEOS-Chem ozone fields and spatial regridding, from the project report (Fig. 1).
image_caption.zh: 项目报告中的 GEOS-Chem 臭氧场与空间重网格示例（图 1）。

alt.en: Original report figure comparing coarse GEOS-Chem ozone fields with spatially regridded fields on 1 January 2020.
alt.zh: 原始报告图，比较 2020 年 1 月 1 日 GEOS-Chem 粗网格臭氧场与空间重网格后的臭氧场。

title.zh: 实证资产定价与股票 Beta 预测

role.en: Project leader · Advisor: Prof. Shuai Qiao, DUT
role.zh: 项目负责人 · 导师：大连理工大学 Shuai Qiao 教授

summary.en: Studied the MAX anomaly in China’s A-share market using CSMAR data, portfolio sorting, Fama–MacBeth regressions, multifactor risk adjustment, and Newey–West inference; explored machine learning for dynamic beta prediction.
summary.zh: 基于 CSMAR 数据，运用投资组合排序、Fama–MacBeth 回归、多因子风险调整与 Newey–West 推断研究中国 A 股 MAX 异象，并探索机器学习动态 Beta 预测。

contribution.en: I reproduced portfolio sorts and Fama–MacBeth regressions, cleaned financial data, and documented rolling training and evaluation for machine-learning beta prediction.
contribution.zh: 我复现投资组合排序与 Fama–MacBeth 回归，完成金融数据清洗，并整理机器学习 Beta 预测的滚动训练与评估流程。
